name: Next Event Estimation for Volumetric Path Tracing
aliases: Volumetric Next Event Estimation with Index-Matching Surfaces
Volumetric Path Tracing with Next Event Estimation
definition: An optimization that adds next event estimation (NEE) to volumetric path tracing by sampling points on light sources and tracing shadow rays through volumes and index-matched surfaces to account for direct lighting.
summary: Next Event Estimation for Volumetric Path Tracing optimizes direct lighting by sampling light sources and tracing shadow rays through participating media and index-matching surfaces.
